source_delta: Keep J07's two one-aircraft units, separate unit-owned fixed mission profiles, two mission types, 8-10 timing, seed, support, result windows and all other parent tables. Replace the OperationParameter all-null placeholder with custom KM, add MissionTypeUtilization rows for both mission types, and update ProblemDescription. The paired inputs swap only rate and unit values between MISSION-A and MISSION-B plus description.
pre_run_hypotheses: Both inputs import/export all populated source tables exactly, convert without errors, simulate two successful 8-10 unit-owned missions and leave both aircraft ready.

Native MissionOperationAccumulated KM increases by 30 each half-hour during both missions. Each unit's MissionOperationTotalAccumulated SOACC is 120 in both paired runs regardless of which rate form it receives.

All-unit MissionOperationTotalAccumulated SOACC is 240 and equals the sum of the two selected unit views. MissionOperationTotal average values must be interpreted against the 36-hour result horizon, not treated as mission totals.

The rate-swapped pair has equal event and observable operation outcomes except for descriptive source labels. Raw native artifacts, settings and source hashes are sealed under the session-0 SSH mutex and GUI guard.
acceptance_requires: published J07 parent and exact three-table source delta
fresh guarded session-0 SSH import/export/calc and zero conversion errors for both variants
valid nonempty SXO, model event logs, default report and exact source roundtrip
valid report settings without fallback for all-unit and both unit selections
per-unit and all-unit SOACC ledger reconciliation, event timeline, report bins, stock and resource negatives, terminal readiness
raw invocation/closure SHA-256 evidence and independent read-only replay
limits: Two unit-owned one-aircraft missions rather than two aircraft in one formation mission; group-member aggregation is not claimed.
Only completed full fixed missions; partial missions, failures, PM consumption, other seeds and mission forms remain unverified.
KM is an abstract user-defined unit, not physically validated kilometres. GUI rendering and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
